events.label: Jason Sexton evaded arrest on Murfreesboro Pike
Nashville police fatal shooting of Jason Sexton

slots.name: shots fired
slots.sentence: Baney then got out, took a position at the rear of a patrol vehicle and fired three times at Sexton as he held the sword, according to police.

slots.name: officer tenure
slots.sentence: Baney, a 12-year Metro Nashville police veteran, was initially told to help block the Hyundai with his police truck, police said.

slots.name: victim status
slots.sentence: Sexton was taken to Skyline Medical Center, where he died.

slots.name: TBI investigation status
slots.sentence: The Tennessee Bureau of Investigation is leading the investigation into the shooting , police said.

slots.name: administrative investigation status
slots.sentence: The Metro Nashville Police Department is conducting a separate administrative investigation into Baney's use of force.

slots.name: woman injury status
slots.sentence: The 26-year-old woman in the back seat of Sexton's Hyundai was not injured, police said.

slots.name: officer authority status
slots.sentence: In the aftermath of the shooting, Metro Nashville Police Chief John Drake directed that Baney be decommissioned and relieved of all police authority while the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation examines the case on behalf of District Attorney General Glenn Funk.
